title: Proof Of Experience (P.O.E.)
tagline: Proof of Experience solves the problem  of authenticating and verifying real experiences. POE is a Dapp for demonstrating the practical application of non-fungible tokens in verifying educational credentials.
description: POE is a Dapp for minting non-transferable NFT's that are tied to digital certificates, creating verifiable learning experiences backed by the Ethereum Blockchain. Ideally PoE will be a site similar to LinkedIn learning or Udemy but where all certifications will be immutable and uploaded onto the blockchain.
how_its_made: We built it using Nft.Storage to house all the metadata for our NFTs and we used Alchmey for testing on the Ropsten test network. Our project used OpenZepplin as a resource when creating our NFT smart contract and we used a create-eth-app boilerplate to get us started. The app is a React application interfacing with the backend using ethers.js
